lesson_title: The One Question That Sorts Everything You Buy
hook_text: One question sorts everything in your trolley. Want to know what it is?
clip_script: R500 and a trolley. Before anything goes in, ask: what happens if we do not buy this? Maize meal: we go hungry. Need. Soap: we get sick. Need. A big packet of chips: nothing bad happens. Want. School shoes with a hole? Need. The branded pair at three times the price? The plain pair does the same job, so the brand is a want. Now zoom out. Your family needs a home and an income. Your community needs a clinic and a road. Your country needs electricity, police and jobs. Needs come first, wants come after.
visual_style: A whiteboard trolley with items dropping into NEED and WANT bins, then four circles growing from me to the country.
mood: Quick and practical, like a game show at the till.
pacing: Rapid item-by-item sorting, then a slow zoom out through the circles.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and run your last shopping trip through the trolley test.
